info.title: Casalume AI Service
info.description:
Internal AI service of Casalume. Only the backend calls it (header `X-Internal-Token`).

* image generation with a provider fallback chain, circuit breakers and a 150 s time budget
* region lock for paint / flooring / replace / targeted declutter: SAM 3 mask, pixels outside it stay the user's
* tap selection: the user taps the objects to change; `/segment` previews the mask before anything is generated
* capture-quality gate, no-change detection
* Claude design chat and shopping/budget analysis
* marketing drafts for the admin (store listing per language)
* every AI answer carries a `usage` cost-ledger entry (API.md §7.2)

Errors: `{"error": {"code", "message", "retryable"}}` — the backend retries only when `retryable` is true.

post.summary: Restyle / edit a room photo (1–4 variants)

422.description: `no_change`: every variant matched the input (usage included)

502.description: `ai_unavailable`: providers failed or the 150 s budget ran out

post.summary: Selection preview: the mask for tapped objects or an object name

422.description: `selection_failed`: nothing usable at the taps (usage included)

post.summary: Shopping list, TL price ranges and renovation lines for a room image
Design chat; suggestions limited to catalog ids
App Store + Google Play listing draft for one language
Caption, hashtags and alt text for a before/after post of one style
Push / e-mail text for a Toplu Gönderim draft
Turkish reading of the owner's weekly numbers
Blog article: written from a topic or translated from a published one
Page titles and meta descriptions for one language
